> Search and download data from the Swiss Federal Statistical Office

BFS gives you the open data of the
[Swiss Federal Statistical Office](https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/catalogue.html)
(BFS, *Bundesamt für Statistik*) in R, as tidy data frames, in German,
French, Italian or English. It covers the four APIs of the BFS:

| You want | Use | API |
|---|---|---|
| Statistics of the Swiss Stats Explorer | `bfs_get_sse_metadata()`, `bfs_get_sse_data()` | [Swiss Stats Explorer](https://stats.swiss/) |
| Datasets of the BFS data catalog | `bfs_get_catalog_data()`, `bfs_get_data()` | [PXWeb](https://www.pxweb.bfs.admin.ch/pxweb/en/) |
| Tables and files (Excel, CSV, PX, ...) | `bfs_get_catalog_tables()`, `bfs_download_asset()` | [DAM](https://dam-api.bfs.admin.ch/hub/swagger-ui/index.html) |
| Maps and geodata | `bfs_get_base_maps()`, `bfs_get_catalog_geodata()`, `bfs_download_geodata()` | [ThemaKart](https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/regional-statistics/base-maps/cartographic-bases.html), [STAC](https://data.geo.admin.ch/api/stac/v0.9/) |

The BFS is replacing STAT-TAB, the platform of the PXWeb API, with the Swiss
Stats Explorer: see
[Get started](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/introduction.html#from-stat-tab-to-the-swiss-stats-explorer).

## Installation

```r
install.packages("BFS")

# or the development version
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("lgnbhl/BFS")
```

## Quick tour

```{r}
library(BFS)
```

### Swiss Stats Explorer

Get the codelists of a dataset, pick the codes you need, and download the
data. The dataset id (here `DF_LWZ_1`, the vacant dwellings) is in the URL
of the dataset on [stats.swiss](https://stats.swiss/).

```{r}
codelist <- bfs_get_sse_metadata("DF_LWZ_1", language = "en")
codelist

bfs_get_sse_data(
  number_bfs = "DF_LWZ_1",
  language = "en",
  query = list(
    GR_KT_GDE = c("4001", "2581"), # Aarau and Olten
    WOHN_ANZAHL = "_T",            # all numbers of rooms
    LEERWOHN_TYP = "4",            # vacant dwellings for rent
    MEASURE_DIMENSION = "OBS"      # number of dwellings (not the rate)
  ),
  start_period = "2020",
  end_period = "2023"
)
```

### Data catalog

Search the BFS data catalog, then download a dataset with its BFS number.

```{r}
bfs_get_catalog_data(language = "en", extended_search = "university students")

bfs_get_data(number_bfs = "px-x-1502040100_131", language = "en")
```

### Tables and files

Many statistics are published as Excel or CSV tables. Search them, then
download the file with its asset number.

```{r}
tables <- bfs_get_catalog_tables(language = "en", extended_search = "students")
tables
```

```r
bfs_download_asset(number_asset = tables$number_asset[1], destfile = "students.xlsx")
```

### Maps

Get the official borders of Switzerland, the cantons, districts or communes
as sf objects.

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(bfs_get_base_maps(geom = "kant")) +
  geom_sf() +
  theme_void()
```

## Learn more

- [Get started](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/introduction.html): which API for which data, and the move from STAT-TAB to the Swiss Stats Explorer.
- [Swiss Stats Explorer](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/swiss-stats-explorer.html): build a query from the codelists.
- [Data catalog and PXWeb datasets](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/pxweb.html): search the catalog and download all or part of a dataset.
- [Tables and files](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/tables-and-files.html): download any BFS file.
- [Geodata and base maps](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/geodata.html): maps of Switzerland and geodata of the Swiss geo-portal.
- [API errors and rate limits](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/troubleshooting.html): what to do when an API is not available.

## Related packages

- [pxweb](https://ropengov.github.io/pxweb/): the PXWeb client used by BFS.
- [rstac](https://brazil-data-cube.github.io/rstac/): the STAC client used by `bfs_download_geodata()`.
- [swissMunicipalities](https://github.com/SwissStatsR/swissMunicipalities): the historicized list of Swiss communes.
- [I14Y](https://felixluginbuhl.com/I14Y/): the metadata of the Swiss interoperability platform I14Y.

## Contributing
